Class ActionPhase

java.lang.Object
model.phaseHandlers.ActionPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhaseHandler, GameCommandVisitor
public class ActionPhase extends Object implements GamePhaseHandler
Handles the Action Phase of a game round, coordinating turn execution for each player according to their position on the offer track.

This handler is responsible for the following lifecycle:

  1. Fetching players from the offer track in left-to-right order.
  2. Resolving the OfferTileAction associated with each player's tile.
  3. Validating and delegating card draw operations via DrawCardCommand.
  4. Advancing the turn automatically when an action is complete or no legal moves remain, or manually when triggered by an EndTurnCommand.
  5. Skipping disconnected players and correctly returning their totems to the turn order to preserve future round sequencing.

Command dispatch follows the Visitor pattern: incoming commands (e.g., DrawCardCommand, EndTurnCommand) are routed to the appropriate visit overload of this handler. Card drawing logic is further delegated to CardDrawer, while legal and forced move validation is handled by MoveChecker, both of which also leverage the Visitor pattern internally.

The phase concludes when no more players remain on the offer track, at which point the state machine transitions to PreEndOfRoundPhase.

    • startNextPlayerTurn

      private void startNextPlayerTurn()
      Initiates the turn for the next player on the offer track.

      Disconnected players are automatically skipped: their totem is returned to the turn order before moving on. If no connected player remains, the phase transitions to PreEndOfRoundPhase.

      Once a valid player is identified, the OfferTileAction for their tile is retrieved and activated. If the action is immediately complete (e.g., empty rows) or no legal move exists, the turn advances automatically without waiting for a player command.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a player's offer tile has no associated action

    • visit

      public void visit(DrawCardCommand cmd) throws Exception
      Processes a DrawCardCommand issued by the active player.

      Resolves the target card by its ID, delegates draw validation to OfferTileAction.canDraw(Card, RowsManager), and executes the draw via CardDrawer. After each draw, checks whether the turn should advance automatically.

      Specified by:
      visit in interface GameCommandVisitor
      Specified by:
      visit in interface GamePhaseHandler
      Parameters:
      cmd - the command carrying the ID of the card the player intends to draw
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no card with the given ID exists on the board
      IllegalStateException - if the current offer tile does not permit drawing the specified card
      Exception - if an unexpected error occurs during draw processing

    • visit

      public void visit(EndTurnCommand cmd) throws Exception
      Processes an EndTurnCommand issued by the active player.

      A player may end their turn voluntarily only when no forced draws remain (i.e., no acquirable character cards are left on the board). If forced moves still exist, the command is rejected.

      Specified by:
      visit in interface GameCommandVisitor
      Specified by:
      visit in interface GamePhaseHandler
      Parameters:
      cmd - the end-turn command (currently unused beyond intent signalling)
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the player still has mandatory draws to complete
      Exception - if an unexpected error occurs during turn advancement

    • checkActionCompletionOrAutoAdvance

      private void checkActionCompletionOrAutoAdvance()
      Automatically advances the turn if the current action is finished or no legal move is available.

      An action is considered finished when the player has drawn the maximum number of cards imposed by their offer tile. A legal move is absent when neither a drawable character card nor an acquirable building card exists in the accessible rows.

    • hasAnyLegalMove

      private boolean hasAnyLegalMove()
      Determines whether at least one legal move is available to the current player.

      A move is considered legal if the player can draw at least one character card or acquire at least one building card from the accessible rows. Delegates evaluation to MoveChecker via the Visitor pattern.

      Returns:
      true if at least one legal move exists; false otherwise

    • hasAnyForcedMove

      private boolean hasAnyForcedMove()
      Determines whether at least one forced (mandatory) move remains for the current player.

      A forced move exists when at least one character card is still drawable. The player may not voluntarily end their turn while forced moves remain. Delegates evaluation to MoveChecker.

      Returns:
      true if a mandatory draw is still available; false otherwise

    • advanceActionTurn

      private void advanceActionTurn()
      Concludes the current player's turn and initiates the next one.

      Returns the current player's totem to the turn order tile, resets the phase's transient state (currentPlayer and currentAction), then delegates to startNextPlayerTurn().

    • skipCurrentPlayerTurn

      public void skipCurrentPlayerTurn()
      Forcibly skips the current player's turn due to disconnection.

      Returns the disconnected player's totem via the disconnection-specific path (which may apply different ordering rules than a normal return), resets transient state, and immediately starts the next player's turn.

      Specified by:
      skipCurrentPlayerTurn in interface GamePhaseHandler
